pois.label: Ledger Bell
pois.hint: Stills nearby weights (incl. strays under the Bell) — measure, then press the Crush

pois.label: Ledger Cache
pois.hint: One weighed drop per visit — E to claim (Doré bone-gold irony)

pois.label: Ledger Shrine
pois.hint: Restores life and breath — kneel to rebalance

pois.label: Ledger Stone
pois.hint: peso e contrapeso — ring the Bell before the Crush

packs.name: Hoard Heart
packs.notes: Wards nearby weights until broken — sits on the Bell–Crush measure

packs.name: Coin Wisps
packs.notes: Scattered greed; small, quick, easy to undervalue

packs.name: Road Weights
packs.notes: First counterweights on the scorched ledger road — learn the measure

packs.name: North Ledger
packs.notes: Tallies unpaid — stills only when the Bell rings

packs.name: South Balance
packs.notes: Scale tipped wrong; push through or pay in blood

packs.name: Weight Champions
packs.notes: Heavy measures before the mid-lane elite

packs.name: Stray Coin
packs.notes: Loose change under the Bell — still them, then tip the Crush

packs.name: Gold Chorus
packs.notes: South-east choir of weights — off the crush lane so the mid road breathes

packs.name: Crush Approach
packs.notes: North flank before the Crush dais — keep the approach readable

packs.name: Ledger Warden
packs.notes: Tablet shield; breaks the ward of the Hoard Heart

packs.name: Counterweight
packs.notes: Mid-lane elite telegraph — the measure tips toward Crush

packs.name: North Measure
packs.notes: Empty ledger flats north of the road — unpaid tallies drift

packs.name: South Spill
packs.notes: Coin spill off the south balance — easy to undervalue

bosses.name: Hoard Crush
bosses.notes: Crushing iron and coin — weight without rest; Doré bone-gold rollers

first_clear.notes: Hoard Crush broken — Avarice yields its measure; bank loot at the Dark Wood stash

daily_quests.objective: Ring the Ledger Bell to still a pack (or North Measure), then break Hoard Crush
daily_quests.notes: Contrapasso of measure: still the weights, tip the Crush; shares UTC daily cap with Dark Wood writ

style_kit.notes: Circle kit 4 of 12; rolling weights, gold-on-black irony, Doré bone-gold; contrapasso of measure; mid-path Ledger Stone beat

legal.notes: Names and short Italian tags only; original encounter design; no assets from other Dante games
